Neuralink creates brain-computer interface devices and surgical robots intended to restore movement and sight and transform digital interaction. The Software Engineer - HIL will own the robot hardware-in-the-loop test system, developing automated verification, integrating tests into CI pipelines, and reproducing failures to improve the reliability of production surgical robots.

Responsibilities
Build and maintain robot HIL — real hardware running production software and firmware
Write automated HIL tests for integration, timing, faults, and bring-up
Define pass/fail, coverage, and acceptance criteria
Wire software-in-the-loop tests, HIL tests, and hardware acceptance into one CI pipeline with logs, traces, and reproducible results
Own release-gating tests. When a failure escapes sim or HIL, you reproduce it and close the coverage gap
